instruction: Set up Brave Search as my default search provider in Chrome.

metadata.explanation: Variation 6: Change default search engine to Brave Search. Uses existing get_default_search_engine getter and match_in_list metric. Evaluator accepts both 'Brave' and 'Brave Search' as valid names.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic correctly extracts default search engine from Chrome Preferences file at the correct JSON path (default_search_provider_data.template_url_data.short_name)
Metric correctly uses match_in_list to check if result is in expected list ['Brave', 'Brave Search'], handling both naming variations
Postconfig correctly restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted to disk before verification
Expected values ['Brave', 'Brave Search'] are semantically correct - these are the actual short_name values Chrome stores for Brave Search
Complete coverage - evaluator checks the exact requirement stated in the instruction
Practical feasibility - getter can access Chrome Preferences file on all platforms (Linux/Windows/macOS), metric comparison is straightforward
Data flow is correct: user changes setting → Chrome restart → read persisted file → compare value
